# CONSUMER_CYCLICALS — 2026-W45 (week to 2026-11-07)

## Coverage changes

Five initiations published, all AUTOS_COMPONENTS, taking the desk to six rated of 168 names [coverage index, 7 Nov]:

- **AUTO** BUY, target Rp4,837 vs Rp3,220 (+58.0%), 7 Nov
- **GJTL** BUY, Rp2,203 vs Rp1,110 (+105.9%), 7 Nov
- **SMSM** BUY, Rp2,718 vs Rp1,595 (+79.9%), 6 Nov
- **IMAS** SELL, Rp458 vs Rp745 (−38.5%), 7 Nov
- **BOGA** SELL, Rp71 vs Rp1,950 (−96.4%), 6 Nov

Reports are at `coverage/companies//report.md`. AUTO and GJTL both underwrite the same GAIKINDO recovery; SMSM is the aftermarket, not the car makers. DRMA was parked a second time when the provider rejected the run before a report existed; it stays unrated. BUVA (REDUCE, Rp269) is unchanged.

## Deck moves

No consumer-industry deck exists, so autos, retail, media, leisure and apparel models read only the house macro deck and no sector input moved. Macro was re-marked twice: USD/IDR 18,140 (4 Nov) to 18,003.5 (6 Nov spot); US 10-year 4.859%; ERP 4.23%, CRP 2.46% and rf_idr 7.45% unchanged [macro deck, 6–7 Nov]. Published WACCs sit at 11.85–11.99% and were not re-cut. The konglo deck (27 Oct) is unchanged; BUVA's target still carries its overlay.

## Material news

Nine-month prints [triage 2–6 Nov]: ERAA revenue Rp63.97trn (+22.2%), profit Rp1.08trn (+38.5%), ERAL profit +55.1%; ACES sales Rp6.9trn, profit Rp604.7bn; PZZA sales Rp765bn (+6%); BELL profit +54.6%; RANS profit Rp37.97bn (+25%). OJK fined three BOGA directors Rp2.47bn over misleading statements on IPO proceeds — the governance finding behind our SELL [4 Nov]. DOOH is buying 6.68bn INET shares for Rp2.005trn [6 Nov]; TMPO was suspended after rising 24.79% [5–6 Nov]. Autos demand split: LCGC sales fell up to 11% while Chinese EVs gained [4–5 Nov].

## What to watch

IDX delists 18 issuers on 10 Nov, five of them desk names (SRIL, TOYS, SBAT, TELE, MABA) still occupying the queue [3–4 Nov]. Gaikindo's November wholesales (10 Dec) test the recovery AUTO and GJTL capitalise, and the LCGC slide is the first evidence against it. DRMA's third attempt.

*Research only; not a recommendation to act.*
